remarks: Wake up to ocean and Dana Point Harbor views from the primary suite in this four-bedroom, three-bath home in the sought-after Viewpointe community of San Juan Capistrano. Set on an expansive, flat lot with a wraparound yard, private courtyard, and a dedicated level pad for a future spa, the property offers plenty of space to relax, entertain, and enjoy ocean views and cool coastal breezes. Inside, the light and bright interior is filled with natural light from large windows throughout. The spacious chef’s kitchen also enjoys ocean views, making it the perfect place to cook and gather.
